about: Fixed nightly evaluation set: premium photorealistic objects, real materials, textures, angles and in-image text. Same prompts + same seed every night so results are comparable over time. Prompts with needs_trigger only run when a trained style LoRA is active; {trigger} is replaced with the plan's trigger word.

prompts.prompt: Premium product photograph of a brushed-steel automatic wristwatch lying on dark slate, three-quarter angle, soft key light from above left with a thin rim light tracing the case edge, crisp brushed grain on the steel, sapphire crystal reflections, 100mm macro lens at f/5.6, black background
prompts.negative: plastic look, blurry, warped numerals, extra hands, watermark

prompts.prompt: Photorealistic studio shot of a heavy crystal whiskey glass with amber liquid and a single clear ice cube, backlit through a softbox so the liquid glows, caustic light patterns on the white marble surface, condensation droplets on the glass, 85mm lens, low eye-level angle
prompts.negative: cartoon, fake reflections, deformed glass, watermark, text

prompts.prompt: Extreme macro photograph of an oiled walnut tabletop edge, raking side light revealing deep wood grain, pores and fine sanding marks, shallow depth of field falling off into warm shadow, 100mm macro lens at f/2.8
prompts.negative: flat lighting, plastic, painted texture, blurry, watermark

prompts.prompt: Close-up product photograph of a full-grain tan leather wallet with visible saddle stitching, natural creases and pebbled grain, resting on folded raw denim, soft window light from the right, 50mm lens at f/4, top-down 45 degree angle
prompts.negative: vinyl look, smooth plastic, blurry stitching, watermark

prompts.prompt: Still life photograph of a handmade matte stoneware mug with a speckled glaze and an unglazed foot ring, on a rough linen cloth next to a river stone, overcast daylight, subtle shadows, 35mm lens at eye level, natural color
prompts.negative: glossy plastic, CGI, perfect symmetry, watermark, text

prompts.prompt: Photorealistic hero shot of a polished chrome espresso machine on a black quartz counter, controlled studio reflections with long strip softboxes, perfectly clean highlights, low 3/4 angle, 50mm lens, dark moody background
prompts.negative: distorted reflections, warped geometry, cartoon, watermark

prompts.prompt: Premium product photograph of a matte black gift box with the word "ATLAS" embossed in gold foil on the lid, exact clean serif lettering, soft top light catching the foil edges, box slightly open, 85mm lens, three-quarter angle, seamless charcoal backdrop
prompts.negative: misspelled text, garbled letters, extra letters, blurry foil, watermark

prompts.prompt: Macro photograph of a solid brass plate engraved with the text "MADE BY HAND" in crisp sans-serif capitals, raking light showing the depth of the engraving and tiny tool marks, slight patina, 100mm macro lens at f/8
prompts.negative: misspelled text, garbled letters, printed-on look, watermark

prompts.prompt: Top-down flat lay photograph of a white leather sneaker with a gum sole, laces neatly arranged, on textured off-white paper with soft shadows, even diffused light, every stitch and perforation visible, 50mm lens directly overhead
prompts.negative: deformed shoe, melted laces, extra soles, watermark, text

prompts.prompt: Dramatic low-angle product photograph of over-ear headphones standing on a concrete plinth, anodized aluminum and soft protein-leather ear pads, hard key light from behind creating a bright rim and long shadow, light haze, 35mm lens, cinematic
prompts.negative: plastic look, warped headband, cartoon, watermark, text

prompts.prompt: High-speed photograph of a lemon slice dropping into sparkling water, frozen splash crowns and bubbles, backlit with a clean white gradient, realistic citrus pulp texture, 100mm lens, 1/8000s look
prompts.negative: cartoon splash, blurry, CGI liquid, watermark

prompts.prompt: Photorealistic still life on a woodworker's bench: a hand plane, curled wood shavings, a steel square and a pencil, warm late-afternoon sun through a dusty window with visible light beams, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field
prompts.negative: cartoon, warped tools, extra objects floating, watermark, text
